# Vynavin Vinod

> Vynavin Vinod is a founder and full stack developer building AI, education technology, and immersive technology products from Brampton, Ontario.

## About

- [Homepage](https://vynavin.tech/): Profile, experience, projects, skills, and contact information for Vynavin Vinod.
- [Awards](https://vynavin.tech/awards.html): Awards and recognition in entrepreneurship, EdTech, AI, and hackathons.
- [Publications](https://vynavin.tech/publications.html): Policy papers, technical whitepapers, and research programs involving Vynavin Vinod.
- [Gallery](https://vynavin.tech/gallery.html): Photos from awards, events, hackathons, and presentations.

## Ventures

- [Questify](https://questify.study): AI-powered education platform founded by Vynavin Vinod.
- SchoolSync: School community app for announcements and engagement, founded and developed by Vynavin Vinod.

## Projects

- Clai-TALOS: Private, local AI agent project developed by Vynavin Vinod.
- Verlia: AI beauty and wellness platform co-founded and developed by Vynavin Vinod.
- GoGarbage: Gamified environmental Web3 application.
- CookieMaps: Cryptocurrency visualization platform.
